vulnerabilityAlerts.description: release-please hides `chore`, so a `chore(deps):` security fix would never cut a release on its own. `fix` makes it a patch release. These skip dashboard approval, so keep a person in front of the merge.

customManagers.description: Tool versions downloaded by .woodpecker/deps.yaml (scripts/ci-fetch-tools.sh), annotated with a renovate comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: Only pr-title.yml runs on a PR (and it is advisory); release-please.yml and cross-platform.yml run only on main, and assignee.yml only when a PR opens.
A bumped step image runs on its own PR, so these may automerge like cargo updates.

Most mise tools are dev-only and CI never calls mise; the rust, cargo-deny and cargo-machete pins are regrouped below with their .woodpecker/ copies. No mise.lock, so nothing for lock file maintenance to refresh.
The mise.toml pin and the .woodpecker/ rust image move together. clippy runs with -D warnings; a new toolchain can fail a green branch. Fix the new lints in the same PR.
The mise.toml pins and the versions .woodpecker/deps.yaml downloads move together.
Cargo.toml uses caret ranges, so in-range updates arrive as named PRs touching Cargo.lock only.
